scenarios.name: xref-file-notopen
scenarios.why: NOTOPEN: the file is not open (IBM CICS TS, READ command conditions): 9200's WHEN OTHER builds WS-FILE-ERROR-MESSAGE and the account is not read

scenarios.name: account-not-found
scenarios.why: NOTFND: no record with that key (IBM CICS TS, READ command conditions): 9300's NOTFND message, then the customer is still read (the program's defect)

scenarios.name: account-io-error
scenarios.why: IOERR: an I/O error (IBM CICS TS, READ command conditions): 9300's WHEN OTHER

scenarios.name: customer-not-found
scenarios.why: NOTFND on the customer (IBM CICS TS, READ command conditions): 9400's NOTFND message

scenarios.name: account-and-customer-not-found
scenarios.why: NOTFND on both (IBM CICS TS, READ command conditions): 9400's NOTFND keeps 9300's message (WS-RETURN-MSG is no longer OFF)

scenarios.name: customer-file-disabled
scenarios.why: DISABLED: the file is disabled (IBM CICS TS, READ command conditions): 9400's WHEN OTHER

scenarios.name: pf3-low-values-caller
scenarios.why: #4049 (proposed for the COACTVWC PF3 survivor): FROM-TRANID and FROM-PROGRAM of LOW-VALUES (not blank) fall back to the main menu

scenarios.name: card-number-blank
scenarios.why: #4443 (mutation survivors in alnumToUnsigned): the card-xref number of account 52 is 16 blanks, MOVEd to the 9(16) CDEMO-CARD-NUM as zero

scenarios.name: card-number-comma-trailing-letter
scenarios.why: #4443 (mutation survivors in alnumToUnsigned): the card-xref number of account 53 is '49,000000000091X': libcob ignores the comma and stops filling at 16 digits, before the letter

scenarios.name: card-number-inner-space
scenarios.why: #4443 (mutation survivors in alnumToUnsigned): the card-xref number of account 54 holds a blank between digits, which the MOVE ignores

scenarios.name: card-number-minus-sign
scenarios.why: #4443 (mutation survivors in alnumToUnsigned): the card-xref number of account 55 leads with a minus: the MOVE to an unsigned item drops the sign

scenarios.name: card-number-trailing-space
scenarios.why: #4443 (mutation survivors in alnumToUnsigned): the card-xref number of account 56 is 15 digits and a trailing blank

scenarios.name: card-number-space-then-plus
scenarios.why: #4443 (mutation survivors in alnumToUnsigned): the card-xref number of account 57 is a blank, a plus sign and 14 digits; its customer is not on file

scenarios.name: card-number-plus-sign
scenarios.why: #4443 (mutation survivors in alnumToUnsigned): the card-xref number of account 58 leads with a plus; its customer is not on file

scenarios.name: card-number-letter-inside
scenarios.why: #4443 (mutation survivors in alnumToUnsigned): the card-xref number of account 59 has a letter O among the digits: any other character met before the receiver is full leaves ZERO

scenarios.name: card-number-all-letters
scenarios.why: #4443 (mutation survivors in alnumToUnsigned): the card-xref number of account 60 is 16 letters: no digit, ZERO

scenarios.name: card-number-letter-digit-mix
scenarios.why: #4443 (mutation survivors in alnumToUnsigned): the card-xref number of account 61 alternates a letter and a digit: the first letter leaves ZERO

scenarios.name: card-number-point
scenarios.why: #4443 (mutation survivors in alnumToUnsigned): the card-xref number of account 62 holds a decimal point among the digits: the MOVE counts only the digits before it

scenarios.name: pf3-xctl-fails-abend-routine
scenarios.why: #6072: reaches ABEND-ROUTINE (HANDLE ABEND LABEL(ABEND-ROUTINE), app/cbl/COACTVWC.cbl:264). PGMIDERR RESP2 3, the program could not be loaded (IBM CICS TS, XCTL conditions): the XCTL back to the caller fails with no RESP, so CICS abends the task and the active HANDLE ABEND passes control to ABEND-ROUTINE

scenarios.name: invalid-key-acts-as-enter
scenarios.why: #6072 (app/cbl/COACTVWC.cbl:307,312): PF5 is neither ENTER nor PF3, so `IF CCARD-AID-ENTER OR CCARD-AID-PFK03` is false (PFK-INVALID stays set) and `IF PFK-INVALID` is true: the key is treated as ENTER and account 1 is read and shown

notes: CardDemo's account view (transaction CAVW), pseudo-conversational: entered from the menu it sends the empty screen; re-entered with an account id it reads the card cross-reference (through the CXACAIX alternate index), the account and the customer, and sends them; PF3 returns to the menu.
